1.explanation: To reproduce the bug, you need to set up a local static server and run a Lighthouse audit on a page that includes iframes loading the specified fonts. The page should not have the `font-display` property set in the CSS for these fonts, which will trigger the audit warnings. The provided shell commands start the server and run the audit, simulating the conditions under which the bug occurs.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves Lighthouse being unable to automatically check the `font-display` value for several web fonts loaded via iframes. The audit warnings indicate that the CSSUsage artifact does not have any stylesheets referencing these fonts, which results in the inability to verify the `font-display` property.
